podcast.title: Formation and Pioneering Western Swing (1932)
podcast.body: Formed in 1932 by Milton Brown after his departure from the Light Crust Doughboys due to low pay and creative differences. The Musical Brownies are widely recognized as the first band to play "proper Western Swing," setting many of the genre's defining characteristics. "Brown left in 1932 to form his own band, The Musical Brownies."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Milton Brown's Untimely Death (1936)
podcast.body: The Musical Brownies experienced massive popularity for a period, but their trajectory was tragically cut short by the death of Milton Brown in a car crash in 1936. "For a while, The Musical Brownies were massively popular, but sadly, Brown died in a car crash in 1936."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 3: "Ida Red" by Bob Wills and the Texas Playboys

podcast.title: Introduction of Electric Steel Guitar
podcast.body: The band introduced the electric steel guitar to the Western music genre, largely through the talent of steel player Bob Dunn, a significant innovation that shaped the sound of Western Swing. "In particular, they introduced electric steel guitar to the Western music genre, with the great steel player Bob Dunn."
